- Added an "Upgrade to Legal Pilot Premium" section, detailing premium features and providing a purchase link.
- Included a "Legal & Compliance Notice" section outlining compliance requirements and limitations.
- No functional code or behavior changes; documentation updates only.

Legal Intake & Case Triage Pilot v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides high-security legal intake and case triage for law firms.
- Enforces strict prevention of unauthorized practice of law (UPL) using ThumbGate rules.
- Collects key intake data for quick conflict checks and statute of limitations screening.
- Ensures HIPAA compliance by redacting sensitive medical information.
- Integrates with popular legal CRMs (Clio, MyCase, Litify) for instant lead management.
- Automatically delivers required disclaimers and enforces no legal advice or outcome guarantees.
